name: Gangsta 2-6
description: Gangsta 2-6 is a Chicago-based street gang and branch of the Gangster Two Six nation, which originated in the Little Village neighborhood along 26th Street on the city's southwest side around 1970. Aligned with the Folk Nation, the gang expanded into Chicago's western suburbs — including Cicero, Berwyn, and Countryside — during the 1980s and early 1990s. The gang is known for a long-standing rivalry with the Latin Kings.
